description: Append 256 distinct index-tagged payloads, flush and reopen; run four concurrent readers over independent ranges in the same immutable log, checking all returned identities and values. Use small chunks and a documented cache-disabled operational configuration to exercise disk reads. Do not prescribe seek/read ordering.
parameter_disclosure: Laboratory design informed by historical source. No blind authorship is claimed. Parameters must be frozen before search; they contain no prescribed failing event sequence.
